items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: George Zach was still on piano. You know, your first band.

ctx.x: Back in the day, what did you call them? Right?

Well, I think he called them. He called them Ancestral. He knew about him. An obstruction. Veins collapsed. He had 16 transfusions. Low-ver pneumonia. They threw the book at you. Oh sure, I was unconscious for six weeks. No kidding. I was operating on it four times. I didn't even know it. Must have just been hanging on the vine then. Oh, I was. I had low-ver pneumonia too. I was unconscious for about 21 days. Didn't know my way from it. See, the first operation was going to be a good one. They couldn't even move…
That's what I don't like. That's music. And that's what I don't like. What? I don't like solos. A bass is a string.
